# ADLC — Agentic Development Life Cycle

> ADLC is a human-governed lifecycle in which AI agents help move work from intent through planning, implementation, verification, review, delivery, and operational learning. AI Fleet is the reference ADLC workspace at this origin.

Canonical URL: https://adlc-9e72f.web.app/
Language: English
Last updated: 2026-08-11

ADLC expands to Agentic Development Life Cycle. It augments software delivery
with goal-directed agents while keeping people responsible for approvals,
policy, and final outcomes. The reference workspace supports intent routing,
planning, isolated implementation, tests and checks, review gates, pull-request
delivery, and operational tracing. Public discovery documents describe the
product; authenticated workspace data and `/api/` routes are not public source
material.

## Authoritative resources

- [Full ADLC overview](https://adlc-9e72f.web.app/llms-full.txt): Definition, lifecycle, capabilities, controls, and citation guidance.
- [ADLC workspace](https://adlc-9e72f.web.app/): Public product entry point and visible summary.
- [AI Fleet source and documentation](https://github.com/niravshah2705/symphony): Implementation, architecture, and operator documentation.
